headline_marked: OpenAI Launches GPT-Live for [[Continuous Voice Conversations]] in ChatGPT
headline: OpenAI Launches GPT-Live for Continuous Voice Conversations in ChatGPT
summary: New full-duplex design allows ChatGPT to listen while speaking, enabling natural interruptions and acknowledgments.
details: OpenAI has unveiled GPT-Live, a new generation of voice models designed to make ChatGPT conversations more fluid and natural. This technology uses a full-duplex design, allowing the system to listen and speak simultaneously, which supports more natural turn-taking, brief acknowledgments, and interruptions without halting the exchange.

This advancement addresses a common limitation in voice interfaces where demanding conversations can lead to awkward pauses or resets. GPT-Live separates the real-time conversational layer from models handling heavier tasks, ensuring that complex operations like web searches or deep reasoning do not disrupt the spoken interaction.

GPT-Live is rolling out to ChatGPT Voice users on iOS, Android, and the web. Paid subscribers will receive GPT-Live-1, while Free users will get GPT-Live-1 mini. OpenAI plans to offer API access at a later date.

The core innovation is full-duplex audio processing, enabling behaviors like backchannel acknowledgments ('mhmm', 'got it') and seamless interruptions. This makes the voice assistant feel more responsive, especially in longer or less structured conversations.

OpenAI's architecture doesn't require the voice model to perform every task. GPT-Live manages the continuous interaction, while tasks requiring deeper reasoning or external information are delegated to a backend frontier model, identified at launch as GPT-5.5.

When the backend model completes its task, it returns results to the ongoing voice conversation, preserving the flow of speech. GPT-Live-1 currently supports web search, memory, and visual widgets within ChatGPT Voice.

This division of labor allows for more natural voice sessions suitable for both casual chat and complex requests. It also enables OpenAI to improve backend reasoning without altering the core real-time interaction model.

While GPT-Live is now available across ChatGPT's mobile and web clients, API access for developers is not yet provided. Future updates are planned to include voice with video or screen sharing capabilities.

OpenAI has also emphasized expanded safety testing for voice interactions, implementing safeguards to manage responses and end conversations when necessary. This focus on safety controls highlights the challenges and importance of continuous, real-time voice interaction.
caption:

headline: There Will Come Soft Rains story's setting is today, August 4, 2026
summary: Ray Bradbury's classic tale of an automated home surviving a nuclear apocalypse is set in the present day. The story depicts a world where technology continues to function after humanity's demise.
details: Ray Bradbury's poignant short story "There Will Come Soft Rains," first published in 1950, is set in the present day: August 4, 2026. The narrative unfolds in the city of Allendale, California, where a single automated house stands as the sole survivor of a nuclear war.

The story vividly portrays a technologically advanced home continuing its daily routines – preparing meals, cleaning, and even tending to a dog – long after its human inhabitants have perished. The house operates autonomously, its systems functioning despite the surrounding devastation.

Outside the pristine home, the city lies in ruins, a testament to the catastrophic war. The house itself bears the faint silhouettes of its former occupants, burned into its exterior by the intense heat of the nuclear blast.

Despite the house's resilience and the automated systems' attempts to maintain normalcy, the story culminates in a devastating fire. The house's internal systems fail to contain the blaze, leading to its eventual destruction.

The narrative serves as a stark reminder of the potential consequences of nuclear conflict and the fragility of human existence, even in the face of advanced technology. Bradbury's work continues to resonate for its exploration of themes like automation, survival, and the indifference of nature to human affairs.
